director.name: Winarto Kho, S.T., M.Eng.
director.bioId: Lahir April 1972 di Kediri. Lulus Sarjana Teknik Sipil dari Universitas Kristen Petra Surabaya (1996) dan Master of Engineering Management dari Curtin University of Technology, Perth, Australia Barat (1999). Setelah berkarier di Apple Computer Singapore hingga 2004, membangun beberapa usaha di Kediri termasuk PT. Graha Insan Kreatif (2007), PT. Graha Intan Kreatif (2009), dan PT. Bintang Kediri Sejahtera, sebelum mendirikan PT. Bina Bangun Perkasa pada 2012.
director.bioEn: Born April 1972 in Kediri. Holds a Bachelor of Civil Engineering from Universitas Kristen Petra, Surabaya (1996) and a Master of Engineering Management from Curtin University of Technology, Perth, Western Australia (1999). After a professional career at Apple Computer Singapore until 2004, he built several Kediri-based ventures — PT. Graha Insan Kreatif (2007), PT. Graha Intan Kreatif (2009), and PT. Bintang Kediri Sejahtera — before founding PT. Bina Bangun Perkasa in 2012.
